prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: mobile-first web app direction comp, portrait iPhone screen
Primary request: a shippable home screen for Open Calory Tracker in a Utility Reading Sheet visual system, where exact food and water inputs become a durable inspectable daily record.
Structure: narrow top utility rail with privacy mark and Settings; compact nearby-date strip with today centered; one broad horizontal calorie meter reading 1,420 / 2,050 kcal; two-page nutrient strip preview; a vertical event log for food and water; thumb-reachable Add food and Add water actions at the lower edge.
Subject/content: Saturday, August 29; Mock data label; breakfast “Greek yogurt with blueberries” 320 kcal at 8:12 AM; lunch “Turkey & avocado sandwich” 540 kcal at 12:36 PM; water 40 fl oz / 80 fl oz; protein 72 / 120 g; carbs 131 / 230 g; fat 44 / 70 g; one Fiber total marked Incomplete; visible USDA FoodData Central attribution on food rows.
Style/medium: realistic polished product UI, not concept art, not a photo of a phone. Municipal meter books, calibration plates, waterproof field paper, stamped reading slips. Matte pale gray-green paper ground; deep petrol ink; turquoise active readings; one coral-orange action seal. Parallelogram-free rectangular layout, precise engraved calibration ticks, slightly condensed humanist sans plus clear tabular numerals.
Composition/framing: full portrait 9:16 app viewport, one-handed iPhone hierarchy, no device frame, dense summary above quieter log, generous readable spacing.
Interaction cues: exact active state and current date use the only illuminated color; vertical time score placement; Add food is the primary action.
Constraints: mobile web app; English; practical WCAG-conscious hierarchy; no photos, no food illustrations, no progress rings, no warm wellness cards, no gamification, no streaks, no badges, no medical claims, no logos, no watermark; render provided labels accurately and do not invent claims.
